variant: B: Appointments, rooms, and scheduling conflicts

domain_invariants.requirement: Room, animal, and appointment ids are immutable positive integers; every non-positive path or referenced id is treated as not found. Persisted appointment timestamps are offset-aware ISO-8601 UTC timestamps from 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z through 2035-12-31T23:59:59Z.
A room has a trimmed unique name of 2..60 characters, room_type in CONSULTATION, SURGERY, IMAGING, capacity 1..20, and active boolean. Its name is unique among non-deleted rooms.

A patient animal has a client_account_id, trimmed name of 1..80 characters, species in DOG, CAT, RABBIT, BIRD, OTHER, and active boolean. A user may access only animals whose client_account_id is the caller account; admins may access all animals.

An appointment references exactly one active room and one active patient animal, has reason after trimming of 3..250 characters, starts and ends on a five-minute UTC boundary, and has a duration from 15 through 240 minutes with end_at strictly later than start_at.

A room cannot have overlapping SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointments. A patient animal cannot have overlapping SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointments. Overlap uses half-open intervals [start_at, end_at), so appointments that share only an endpoint do not conflict.

Appointment status transitions are SCHEDULED to CHECKED_IN or CANCELLED, and CHECKED_IN to COMPLETED or CANCELLED. COMPLETED and CANCELLED are terminal and their planned time, room, and patient cannot be changed.

Cancellation records are immutable history containing cancelled_at in the timestamp range of REQ-3-001, cancellation_reason of 3..500 trimmed characters, and the cancelling account. Cancelling releases the room and patient conflict slots without deleting the appointment.

A room may be deactivated only if it has no SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointment. A room may be soft-deleted only if no appointment of any status references it; deletion never cascades to appointments.

A user may create, read, modify while SCHEDULED, check in, complete, or cancel only appointments for that user's patient animals; admins may operate all appointments and are the only role that manages rooms. Private routes deny by default.

Every list uses immutable ascending numeric id order, limit 1..100 default 20, and optional after_id greater than zero, returning items and next_after_id null when exhausted. Appointment time filters are inclusive at both bounds for start_at and require from not later than to; conflict queries use the half-open overlap semantics in REQ-3-005.

seed_data: The only roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; all other routes require a valid, non-expired server-side Bearer session and use deny-by-default authorization.
Seed data includes two user accounts, one admin account, two active patient animals owned by different user accounts, and active rooms of each allowed room_type.
JSON write endpoints require application/json. Malformed JSON is 400, unsupported media type is 415, and a syntactically valid payload that violates a declared field is 422.
The service uses only local persistence. Persistence unavailability is 503 and an unexpected local failure is 500; both preserve all persistent records.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization requirement; it shall check only local persistence, return deterministic service status without persistent effects, and emit only 200 or 503.

The system shall expose GET /rooms to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional room_type, active boolean, include_deleted boolean permitted only to admins, name_prefix of 1..60 characters, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-3-002 and REQ-3-010, return stable pages without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListRooms(request):
    // REQ-3-012; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401. REQUIRE admin when include_deleted is true OR RETURN 403.
    VALIDATE enum, booleans, prefix, and REQ-3-010 pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422. READ matching rooms by ascending id.
    RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition: rooms and appointments remain unchanged on success and error.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /rooms to an admin, accepting JSON name, room_type, capacity, and optional active default true; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-3-002, atomically create a unique non-deleted room, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /rooms/{room_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive room_id; it shall enforce REQ-3-001 and return the non-deleted room without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 401, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetRoom(request, room_id):
    // REQ-3-014; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401. IF room_id is non-positive, absent, or deleted THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    RETURN 200 with room. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged; all errors have no side effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /rooms/{room_id} to an admin, accepting a positive room_id and JSON name, room_type, capacity, or active; it shall require application/json, validate the resulting room under REQ-3-002 and the deactivation condition in REQ-3-008, atomically update only supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, preserve appointment relations, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /rooms/{room_id} to an admin, accepting a positive room_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only a room with no appointment of any status as required by REQ-3-008, be idempotent only insofar as a deleted id is 404, never cascade to appointment records, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /animals to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional species, active boolean, client_account_id allowed only to admins, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-3-003 and REQ-3-010, restrict a user to animals mapped to that user account, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /animals to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON name, species, and optional active default true plus an optional positive client_account_id only for admins; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-3-001 and REQ-3-003, require a supplied client_account_id to identify an existing account, assign a user-created animal to the caller account, atomically create it, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /animals/{animal_id} to its client user or an admin, accepting a positive animal_id; it shall enforce REQ-3-001 and REQ-3-003, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetAnimal(request, animal_id):
    // REQ-3-019; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin OR RETURN 401. RETURN 404 for non-positive or absent id. REQUIRE caller is client owner or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200 with patient animal. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors have no side effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /appointments to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional positive animal_id, positive room_id permitted only to admins, status, from, to, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-3-001, REQ-3-004, REQ-3-006, inclusive start_at filter semantics and REQ-3-010, restrict a user to appointments for that user's animals, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /appointments to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON positive animal_id, positive room_id, reason, start_at, and end_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-3-001, REQ-3-004, and REQ-3-005, require the user caller to own the animal, atomically create a SCHEDULED appointment after locking conflict slots, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /appointments/{appointment_id} to the appointment's patient client user or an admin, accepting a positive appointment_id; it shall enforce REQ-3-001 and REQ-3-009, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose PATCH /appointments/{appointment_id} to the appointment's patient client user or an admin, accepting a positive appointment_id and JSON reason, room_id, start_at, or end_at; it shall require application/json, permit changes only while SCHEDULED, validate the resulting appointment under REQ-3-004 and REQ-3-005, atomically update only supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, preserve cancellation history, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handlePatchAppointment(request, appointment_id):
    // REQ-3-023; preconditions: JSON request, existing appointment, and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated patient client or admin OR RETURN 401 or 403. REQUIRE application/json OR RETURN 415.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock appointment, resulting room, animal, and conflict slots. IF status is not SCHEDULED THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    VALIDATE resulting REQ-3-004 appointment OR ROLLBACK; RETURN 400 or 422. IF room missing then ROLLBACK; RETURN 404; IF REQ-3-005 conflict then ROLLBACK; RETURN 409.
    UPDATE supplied fields; COMMIT; RETURN 200. // Identical valid payload is idempotent; rollback preserves all relations.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /appointments/{appointment_id}/check-in to the appointment's patient client user or an admin, accepting a positive appointment_id and JSON checked_in_at in the timestamp range of REQ-3-001; it shall require application/json, allow only a SCHEDULED appointment to become CHECKED_IN when checked_in_at is within its planned interval, atomically preserve room and patient occupancy, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /appointments/{appointment_id}/complete to the appointment's patient client user or an admin, accepting a positive appointment_id and JSON completed_at in the timestamp range of REQ-3-001; it shall require application/json, permit only CHECKED_IN appointments and require completed_at not earlier than checked_in_at, atomically mark COMPLETED, be non-idempotent, retain all room and patient relations, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /appointments/{appointment_id}/cancel to the appointment's patient client user or an admin, accepting a positive appointment_id and JSON cancelled_at plus cancellation_reason; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-3-001 and REQ-3-007, permit only SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointments, atomically create immutable cancellation history and mark CANCELLED, be non-idempotent, release conflict occupancy without deleting relations, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /rooms/{room_id}/appointment-conflicts to an admin, accepting a positive room_id, required start_at and end_at, optional positive exclude_appointment_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-3-001, REQ-3-004, and REQ-3-010, return SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN overlapping appointments using REQ-3-005, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /animals/{animal_id}/appointment-conflicts to the animal's client user or an admin, accepting a positive animal_id, required start_at and end_at, optional positive exclude_appointment_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-3-001, REQ-3-004, and REQ-3-010, return SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN conflicts using REQ-3-005 without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.
